original_test_intent: Validate every Type 40 Additional Information entry as a bounded variable record whose handle, referenced offset, optional string and value bytes consistently describe the referenced SMBIOS field, stable across reboot.
original_method: Walk all entries by length, resolve each referenced handle and offset against complete raw SMBIOS structures, validate string index and value extent/type under approved field metadata, preserve unresolved proposal semantics and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies versioned field semantics and policy for proposed/unknown entries and approves reboot; structural/cross-reference checks are automated.
required_inputs: Applicable Type 40 entry layout and minimum length
Policy for optional string, proposed enum values, duplicates and reboot
safety_requirements: Use read-only raw tables; never write a referenced field or firmware.
Bounds-check entry header/value before dereference and never resynchronize a malformed entry by guess.
Reject dangling handles and offsets outside the referenced formatted section.
Do not auto-retry reboot; stop on recovery failure.
agent_execution_scope: For each entry, validate length/bounds, resolve handle/type, validate referenced offset/field width, optional string and value-size relationship, then diff the complete map across reboot.
Surface syntactically valid but semantically proposed/unknown values to the engineer without inventing meaning or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve versioned field metadata and proposed/unknown/duplicate-entry policy.
Interpret unresolved proposal semantics and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The text selector cannot parse variable entry boundaries or establish any referenced handle/offset/string/value relationship.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw Type 40 plus all referenced structures; emit per-entry offset/length, target handle/type/offset, resolved field width/type, string/value bytes, boundary/cross-reference result and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The full entries scope, Type 40 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no table changes are added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Parse every bounded entry, resolve target structure/field through versioned metadata, validate optional string and value extent, and retain unknown proposal semantics for owner review across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing SMBIOS Type 40 Additional Information.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, decoder/parser and field-metadata version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 40 Additional Information Entry and referenced-structure definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces label grep with a complete entry-to-field referential and boundary proof.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects short/overflowing entries, dangling handles, invalid offsets/string indices, wrong value extents and semantic drift.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Versioned field schema and unknown/proposed-value policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Type 40 can carry not-yet-approved values; structural validity does not by itself establish semantic acceptance.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define interpretation of vendor/proposed values, but cannot override entry boundaries, target-handle integrity or the referenced field's published width.
expected_evidence: Applicable layout, field schema and semantic policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 40, referenced structures and string areas
Per-entry boundary, target handle/type/offset, field width/type, optional string and value mapping
Explicit list of unresolved proposed/unknown semantics
Approved reboot/health record and full post-reboot cross-reference diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items intentionally covers the complete entries region; full structural and semantic cross-reference validation preserves that breadth.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core parsing and comparison are automatable after version/schema inputs; unresolved semantic values can be reported for verdict without blocking execution.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds per-entry boundaries and complete target field/string/value validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains proposed-value escalation while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates semantic inputs and engineer verdict from structural execution capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a displayed entry label from masking a value attached to the wrong structure field or extending beyond either record boundary.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Type 40 entry is a cross-structure assertion; correctness requires both local framing and globally valid target/field/string/value relationships, while proposal acceptance remains engineer-owned.
